purpose: A date page I have not read, a door to odd corners for a joke about the day.

pages.title: November 27
pages.reaction: A calendar page for November 27, full of dates and no story. The 1968 line about Penny Ann Early playing in a men's league and the 1971 Mars module that crashed but still touched the surface are the bits that snag me. Mostly it was a door to corners, which is fine for a joke about the day, but thin …
